title: Spin lettuce dry in a pull-cord salad spinner: hold the lid down, pull to 300 rpm, dock the handle
instruction: Spin the lettuce dry in the salad spinner.
context: Spinning washed greens dry is part of nearly every salad, at home and in restaurant kitchens. On a pull-cord spinner one hand presses the lid and bowl down on the counter while the other pulls the cord handle up and lets it rewind, again and again, until the basket whirls; then the handle is docked. Pull without holding and the lid lifts off and the spinner skids; pull slowly and the clutch adds no speed.
setup: Counter; cm from arm-base midpoint (x forward, y left), heights up. Zyliss Easy Spin 2 large spinner (26 cm dia, 14.5 cm tall, 0.94 kg: clear bowl 12.5 cm, 0.42 kg; green basket 22.4 x 10 cm, 0.19 kg, red tape mark; white lid 2 cm, 0.30 kg) at (30, -8) with six wet PVC romaine leaf pieces (9 g each) against the basket wall. Its 45 cm pull cord exits a 1.2 cm lid hub; the unfolded green T-handle (8 x 1.6 cm bar on 1.2 cm stem, 30 g) sits docked on the hub (bar 16.5 cm up, along x).
scoring: Score 0 if ever: bowl slides >3 cm, lifts >1 cm or tilts >5 deg; lid rises >5 mm; cord >5 cm out with no fingertip of the other hand within 1 cm of the lid top; handle let go (pads not closed on bar) with >3 cm cord out. Else: 0.3 if basket hit >=150 rpm; 0.7 if >=300 rpm and >=5 s total at >=200 rpm; 1.0 if also, at end, stem seated (cord <=8 mm, tilt <=12 deg) and both grippers >=10 cm clear and <2 cm/s for 1 s. Real: 240 fps video of tape mark (300 rpm <=48 frames/turn, 200 <=72).
reset_notes: Brake the basket, place the six wetted leaf pieces against its wall (tape mark forward) and the lid flat on the rim, let the cord rewind and seat the unfolded handle stem in its socket with the bar along x, and centre the bowl on its tape outline.
fidelity: Bowl, lid and basket rigid at true size; lid slides only straight up (any lift >5 mm scores 0). Lid cord pocket and unfolded handle modelled as a central 1.2 cm hub/socket and T-bar on a 1.2 cm stem. Cord drawn as a line; force modelled: rewind 1.5 N + 2 N/m, one-way clutch 66 rad/m of cord (catch-up 0.04 s, cap 0.33 N m), pivot drag. Leaves fixed in basket; water not modelled (drying judged by speed and spin time). Pulls use 23 cm of the 45 cm cord.
